openQuestions.text: Would the two currently-not-run REQUIRED checks convert a would-be PASS into not-run, or does REQ-006 alone already forbid a vacuous PASS?
Should 'required for PASS' be an explicit property of each enumerated check, separate from 'executes'?

resolvedQuestions.text: Which check is load-bearing for the PASS verdict?
resolvedQuestions.answer: authority-state; its FAIL drives verdict FAIL even with two not-run checks

keyFindings.text: authority-state is the load-bearing check; its FAIL drives the verdict
Failure root cause is a missing compiled authority-registry.js artifact, not a policy conflict
Durable authority states exist (legacy_authoritative, new_authoritative_reversible, new_authoritative_final); declared PASS condition unmet
Frozen-candidate contract holds for executable checks (tree-clean, candidate-frozen, runtime-suite all pass)
not-run is recorded honestly and cannot manufacture a PASS because the decisive check already FAILED

ruledOutDirections.approach: Treating authority-state module-resolution as a semantic authority disagreement
ruledOutDirections.reason: Compiled registry .js artifact is absent, not a demonstrated state conflict
Its not-run reason explicitly defers to the already-determined verdict
